title: Proper/open counit is monic
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, $p:V\to T$ a proper morphism, $i:W\hookrightarrow T$ an open immersion, and $M : \operatorname{Mod}_{A}(V\times_TW)$. Then $Mono\left((sfIntrinsicExtensionByZeroAdjunction(i,A)).counit.app((sfIntrinsicExtensionByZero(pullback.fst(p,i),A)\circ p_*).obj(M))\right)$.

proof.text: The sectionwise zero-extension map is injective before sheafification, and exact module sheafification preserves this injectivity. Base change to affine pro-etale objects identifies the resulting map with the displayed counit component.
